title: Multi-View Molecular Representation Learning with Hierarchical Graphs and Contextualized Fingerprints
abstract: arXiv:2609.15611v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Molecular property prediction requires representations that generalize from limited labeled data to structurally novel compounds. Existing molecular pretraining methods often rely on a single view: graph-based approaches model atom-bond topology but provide limited fragment-level supervision, whereas fingerprint descriptors encode chemical patterns but are typically used as fixed auxiliary features. We propose HiFi-Mol, a multi-view framework that separately pretrains a hierarchical graph encoder and a contextualized fingerprint encoder before downstream integration. The graph branch uses fragment-aware masking with multi-resolution supervision to capture substructure-aware representations, while the fingerprint branch tokenizes active entries from seven fingerprint families and applies masked language modeling to learn contextualized embeddings. translated_title: 基于层次图与上下文化指纹的多视角分子表示学习
translated_abstract: 分子性质预测需要能够从有限的标注数据泛化到结构新颖化合物的表示方法。现有的分子预训练方法通常依赖于单一视角：基于图的方法对原子-键拓扑结构进行建模，但提供的片段级监督有限；而指纹描述符能够编码化学模式，但通常仅被用作固定的辅助特征。我们提出了HiFi-Mol，这是一个多视角框架，在下游整合之前分别预训练一个层次图编码器和一个上下文化指纹编码器。图分支采用具有多分辨率监督的片段感知掩码策略来捕获子结构感知的表示，而指纹分支则对来自七个指纹家族的活性条目进行标记化，并应用掩码语言建模来学习上下文化嵌入。在微调阶段，HiFi-Mol将投影后的多分辨率图特征与指纹……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出HiFi-Mol多视角框架，通过分别预训练层次图编码器和上下文化指纹编码器并在下游进行整合，实现子结构感知与上下文化化学模式的双重捕获，提升分子性质预测在有限标注数据下的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: HiFi-Mol is a multi-view framework that separately pretrains a hierarchical graph encoder with fragment-aware masking and a contextualized fingerprint encoder via masked language modeling, integrating both views to improve generalization in molecular property prediction from limited labeled data.
